faq.a: Day 1: AI and the agent formula. Day 2: job description. Day 3: memory and context. Day 4: build your first agent with Claude Code. Day 5: test, secure and deploy.
Certificates for Claude come directly from Anthropic. We prepare you for them; we do not issue them ourselves.
Classes are live online, and recordings are shared so you can review them.
You need a laptop or computer with internet and a free Claude account to start.
